svg.text: Five agreement types across three layers. Driver memberships gate access. Three bearer codes (ORG, USR, TRD). All shape-deciding questions answered (see "Locked decisions" below).
Straumvakt's revenue from each customer party. Independent of operations.

g.text: "The CPO uses our platform to operate chargers."
USRF — per user on installation 75 kr
"The contractor invoices service work via our platform."
SRF (service line item) — defined later by issues engine.
"The workplace pays employees' bills via our platform."
Required if workplace covers ANY driver bills.
One WRK fee per workplace-covered driver — invoiced once,
not duplicated per CPO the workplace covers them at.

svg.text: CPO-authored. Independent of Straumvakt's commercial terms.

g.text: "What it costs to operate this installation."
DSO — DSO grid fee bound to DSO rate table (fixed)
ELE — Energy bound to electricity rates (fixed)
MTR — E-meter daily fee (CPO-set; bearer ORG by default)
RNT — Charger rental (only if chargers rented, not owned)
IDL — Idle power loss (MDU only — CPO can split with USR)
Gates which factors can be enlisted.
Gates which audience flavors can join.
Gates whether TRD bearer is allowed.
"Krónan covers some installation factors for K-staff at N1."
No new factors — only BearerRule overrides on
An override can only redirect cost AWAY from drivers,
never reduce what the workplace owes per the agreement.

svg.text: No implicit defaults. A driver charges only when they hold a membership covering the charger's installation.

installation_type=public requires a default DriverGroup at the installation contract.
